Oneliner

Educational mission to take photos from space and use machine learning in-orbit.
Description

Take pictures from space and automatically identify the Hawaiian Islands using Machine Learning Algorithms - this will demonstrate improved onboard operational autonomy in space. A secondary goal of this project is to promote Aerospace Education and Workforce training in Hawaii.
